description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core API controller named SystemDataController that handles GET requests to retrieve various types of system data from the database, serialize it into JSON, and send it as a downloadable file.

classes.name: SystemDataController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core API controller that exposes an endpoint for retrieving various system-related data entities from the database.

methods.name: GetData
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to fetch specified entities' data, serialize to JSON, and return as a downloadable file.

methods.name: BuildLoaders
methods.description: Builds and returns a dictionary mapping entity names to functions that fetch data asynchronously from the database.
